About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior AI and Full-Stack engineer residing in South Korea — from Uzbekistan, living and working in Korea since 2023; fluent in Korean, English, and Russian.
About.p2: Engineered core architecture for Blue Networks' E-Chae-Um EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) using Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded MySQL/PostgreSQL — implementing OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 protocol, real-time WebSocket telemetry pipelines, bulk OTA firmware distribution, and KECO/Smartro PG settlement synchronization.
About.p3: Built custom enterprise LLM platforms: fine-tuned LoRA Qwen/Llama classifiers outperforming gpt-4o on proprietary benchmarks with zero query inference cost, featuring multi-lingual streaming copilot capabilities.
About.p4: Integrates premier LLM foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), TypeScript ecosystem (Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js) streaming AI assistants, voice-to-text (STT/TTS), and containerized deployments across Docker, NGINX, Linux, AWS, and GCP.

flagship.title: Blue Networks EV CSMS: Real-Time OCPP & WebSocket Telemetry Platform
flagship.problem: Achieving zero-downtime bidirectional telemetry, remote OTA firmware dispatch, and live status sync across 1,600+ fast/slow EV charging stations across 500+ locations in Korea.
flagship.solution: Architected high-concurrency WebSocket gateways handling OCPP 1.6-J / 2.0.1 protocols with Spring Boot, MyBatis, Redis caching, and automated KECO/ME roaming & Smartro PG settlement pipelines.

aiRag.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent & Vector RAG Pipeline
aiRag.desc: Low-latency token streaming with Vercel AI SDK, hybrid dense/sparse vector retrieval (pgvector), and recursive self-correcting agent workflows.
